Luxury property details

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a detailed property listing page for a luxury home. Include these sections:

1. IMAGE GALLERY
- Hero image (full-width)
- Thumbnail strip below
- Photo count badge
- Fullscreen gallery modal
- Virtual tour button
- Video walkthrough button
- "Share" and "Save" buttons
- Print listing option

2. PROPERTY HEADER
- Price: $1,250,000
- Address: 123 Oak Avenue, City, State ZIP
- Beds: 4 | Baths: 3.5 | Sq Ft: 3,200 | Lot: 0.5 acres
- Status: Active (with colored badge)
- Days on market
- MLS #: 12345678
- Property type: Single Family Home

3. QUICK ACTIONS BAR (Sticky)
- Schedule Tour button
- Request Info button
- Save/Favorite heart
- Share dropdown (copy link, email, social)

4. PROPERTY DESCRIPTION
- Compelling property narrative
- Key highlights called out
- Recent updates mentioned
- Neighborhood highlights
- Expandable "Read More" for long text

5. KEY FEATURES GRID
- Year Built: 2018
- Garage: 2 cars
- Heating: Central
- Cooling: Central A/C
- Basement: Finished
- Pool: Yes
- Fireplace: Gas
- Appliances included

6. ROOM DETAILS TABLE
- Room name, dimensions, level, flooring
- Living Room: 20x18, Main, Hardwood
- Primary Bedroom: 18x16, Upper, Carpet
- Kitchen: 15x12, Main, Tile
- etc.

7. INTERIOR FEATURES
- Grouped lists: Kitchen, Bathroom, Flooring, Windows, etc.
- Granite counters, stainless appliances, etc.

8. EXTERIOR & LOT
- Lot features, landscaping
- Patio/deck details
- Fencing
- Outdoor amenities

9. LOCATION & MAP
- Interactive map (Google/Mapbox)
- Street view link
- Nearby places:
  - Schools (with ratings and distance)
  - Shopping
  - Restaurants
  - Parks
  - Public transit
- Commute time calculator
- Walk Score, Bike Score, Transit Score

10. PRICE HISTORY
- Timeline of price changes
- Original list price
- Price reductions with dates

11. TAX & FINANCIAL INFO
- Annual property taxes
- HOA fees (if applicable)
- Estimated mortgage calculator
- Down payment slider
- Interest rate input
- Monthly payment breakdown

12. SIMILAR PROPERTIES
- Carousel of 4-6 comparable homes
- Same area, similar price range
- "View More Like This" link

13. CONTACT AGENT SECTION
- Agent photo and name
- Phone, email, text options
- Contact form
- Schedule showing calendar picker

14. LEGAL DISCLAIMERS
- MLS data disclaimer
- Fair housing statement
- Data accuracy notice

Design: Clean, image-focused with lots of whitespace. Sticky navigation for long scroll. Mobile: Collapsible sections, swipeable gallery. Primary color: Navy (#0F172A). High-quality photography essential.
